reviewerOrPass: Worker A separately identified same-AI source-first final pass
method: After preparing the exact positive pair, returned to actual NIP group topology and primary module CO/LO/AR, the current curriculum chart, Annex 1 and OER articles, then actual current UCR political, empirical, social-psychological and communication content. Re-read all finished scope fields, 21 component weights, both 24-course schedules, exact course rows, 13 partial matches/eight blanks, optional research and all 31 selected descriptions. This is a separately identified source-first challenge by the same AI; no independent human, different model or separate agent endorsed it.
strongestObjection: A 95 EC core excludes advanced specialization and final research; UCR cannot reproduce the Dutch political system sequence or all political psychology. A communication emphasis must not be generated solely from an optional media title or substitute generic persuasion for political science. The published 180 EC sum alone proves neither eligibility nor academic equivalence.
adjudication: The restricted claim is supported by a specified, substantial compulsory academic object: national/comparative/international/EU politics, theory, philosophy, economics, qualitative/quantitative inquiry, psychology and research design. Both UCR plans retain all six politics courses, substantive quantitative and qualitative research and meaningful social/psychological study. The second adds actual rhetoric, framing/persuasion, ideological language, representation and bargaining inquiry while retaining the political foundations. Dutch politics and complete political-psychology depth remain explicitly different. The limited comparison does not depend on the uninstantiated advanced choices, 10 EC seminar or 20 EC thesis.
adverseTest: A future package heavily weighted to Dutch policy, security, communication, political behaviour or intensive specialized thesis methods could reverse a whole-degree claim. All 55 EC of restricted/final study are therefore unassessed, not declared immaterial. The independently specified 95 EC core and the genuine uninstantiated 30 EC open category survive without invented module membership or waivers.
candidateChallenge: Two concepts were specified before selection. Both actual schedules pass 24 unique courses, 180 EC, six terms, Year-1 PPD and advanced requirements. They differ by seven courses/52.5 EC each way for substantive institutional-economic versus democratic-public communication priorities. A dedicated climate third candidate is not supported as a stable selected direction in the assessed core; stop without a third. All 32 inherited registry rows retain compiler exclusion; concepts are independently based on exact NIP official sources.
alignmentChallenge: Dutch Politics and the broad theories/approaches component remain separate blanks; no generic title-based replacement. Political-psychology correspondence is only to actual social influence, attitudes, group and prejudice content. Public Economics addresses an identifiable economic/public-choice part, not full rational-choice equivalence. Data Science aligns to an important actual R/data-analysis function, complemented by the separate real statistics and econometrics sequence. Neither design/report functions nor hypothetical projects force remaining research rows. All excluded choices/open/final work remain unmatched. Optional research stays outside each 180 EC and is placed with PPD because final-work comparison is withheld.

uncertaintyTests.fact: Applicable later NIP course eligibility/offerings, five-of-ten restricted-choice combinations and seminar/thesis entry and assessment remain unverified.

adverseResolutions.resolution: Restricted choices and final research impose intensive specialized domestic, security, communication or psychological training.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: This could alter whole-degree comparability and is not called immaterial. The 55 EC restricted/final-work scope is explicitly unassessed; it cannot erase the independently specified compulsory 95 EC political and methodological core. No final-work match or elective package is certified.

adverseResolutions.resolution: Future adopted rules change entry sequencing, assessment or available choices.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: No full valid pathway or eligibility is claimed. The current compulsory core and actual UCR teaching remain the evidence for the narrow academic judgment. Reassess a future complete-degree comparison when those rules are available; do not borrow outgoing POL/IP or IRO conditions.

uncertaintyTests.fact: Open-study individual permission, nonoverlap, sufficient level and placement availability remain conditional.

adverseResolutions.resolution: A selected minor, exchange or internship is unavailable or refused.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: No such selection is instantiated or used to support the academic match. The actual 30 EC category and its conditions are preserved separately; the 95 EC compulsory-core judgment does not depend on particular open contents.

conclusion: Qualified comparison of the confirmed 95 EC compulsory political-science core is academically defensible with two complete UCR programmes and explicit known gaps. All 180 published external EC are retained; complete progression, restricted-choice package and final work are not certified. Local final checks, complete publication readback and applicable CI must still pass before approval.
